description.en: Initial mucosal incision at 45–80° with a cutting mode, extension by 1.5–2 cm cranial-to-caudal in the planned tunnel axis with minimum ESU taps.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for mucosotomy technique but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs mucosotomy technique independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches mucosotomy technique to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
